drop_reason: Rohlik Group is a large grocery business with its own warehouses, vans and operations in six countries. Its team is far above the 500 limit, and it has raised hundreds of millions.

growth_signal.value: About 750,000 customers in 2021 and expansion to several countries.

entry.idea: People hate carrying heavy shopping, so Rohlik delivers groceries to the door within 60 minutes or in a 15-minute slot.
entry.lesson: Own the whole chain, from software to delivery, to give a service rivals cannot match.
entry.name: Rohlik
entry.not_startup_reason: Rohlik Group is a large grocery business with its own warehouses, vans and operations in six countries. Its team is far above the 500 limit, and it has raised hundreds of millions.

growth.reason: Expanded to five countries and raised large rounds.

market.reason: Groceries are a huge market in every country.

tech.reason: Solid in-house software and logistics, but others can copy the model.

entry.twist: It runs its own warehouses, fleet and software, so it can offer 17,000 items at shop prices.
entry.who_pays: Households pay for their groceries and a delivery fee.
entry.why_now: More people are happy to buy food online, and delivery software has become good enough to make it pay.
